q: In Salad Dressing, which brand's entire line comes off the planogram?
explain: Wishbone comes off completely. Newman's Own moves up from the bottom shelf into the top 2 shelves, and the new Kraft 8 oz items go on shelf 5.

q: Which brand now leads the Frozen Meatless set?
explain: MorningStar leads and swaps places with Impossible. There are no facing changes.

q: The Frozen Meatless change touches every door in the set.
explain: Only doors 1 and 2 are touched, with one delete and no new items. Full set strips are coming, so bring them.

q: In the Bleach set, where does the smaller liquid bleach go?
explain: Start at the top and work down. The smaller liquid bleach drops to the bottom shelf.

q: Select everything that comes off safers in Family Planning.
explain: Safers come off all pregnancy tests and lubes. The listed condoms and pills stay in safers in every POG, so every POG gets walked.

q: Which stores need 7 extra pegboard pegs for Hair Care Accessories?
explain: Hair Care Accessories pegboard pegs: stores 19, 215 and 682. The magna bar pegs for Personal Care Appliances go to 23, 28, 215 and 391.

q: How did the extra pegs for Personal Care Appliances reach the stores?
options: By store mail with a green label
explain: They shipped by store mail with a green label: hold for the Kompass team. Track them down before starting the set.

q: What is the longest cold product can be out during the fresh sets?
explain: Every cold set has a 20-minute limit on product out of refrigeration.

q: Where does the Simple Truth kimchi go?
explain: The kimchi leaves Lunchmeat for Convenient Snacking, and a Claussen Whole Dill Pickle takes its place in Lunchmeat.

q: Which brands are deleted from NF Chips & Snacks?
explain: Good Eat'n, Kindling, Angie's and Quest are deleted. Frito-Lay and Siete gain facings, and Siete and Boulder Canyon chips form a vertical block.

q: What happens to trial size sets and mobility racks?
options: They are held until next week
explain: They are non-Kompass events. The store signs them out, or they come back as byway issues.

q: Fishing strips get loaded this week.
explain: Hold any fishing strips and do not load them. Fishing moved to P10W4.

q: Select the District 8 stores converting to Artisan with the Asian POG next week.
explain: Stores 23, 31 and 658 convert. Keep branded rack strips in place and do not install Kompass strips on those racks.

q: Who takes the new fuel items out to the fuel station?
explain: Kompass does not transport merchandise between the store and the fuel station. Ask the store to take the new items out.
